description: Header file defining the GLConsumer class, which manages OpenGL texture buffers from a BufferQueue, including buffer management, EGLImage handling, and context attachment/detachment.

classes.name: GLConsumer
classes.description: Manages buffers of graphics data from a BufferQueue, providing them as textures to OpenGL, with methods for buffer and context management.

classes.name: EglImage
classes.description: Utility class for tracking and creating EGLImageKHR objects from GraphicBuffers, with reference counting and binding capabilities.

methods.name: updateTexImage
methods.description: Acquires the most recent buffer and updates the texture image.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the current texture image.

methods.name: setReleaseFence
methods.description: Stores a fence to signal when the current buffer is no longer being read.

methods.name: getTransformMatrix
methods.description: Retrieves the 4x4 texture coordinate transform matrix.

methods.name: computeTransformMatrix
methods.description: Computes the transform matrix from buffer parameters.

methods.name: scaleDownCrop
methods.description: Scales the crop rectangle to match buffer aspect ratio.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the current texture.

methods.name: getCurrentDataSpace
methods.description: Retrieves the dataspace of the current texture.

methods.name: getFrameNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the frame number of the current texture.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the default buffer size for requestBuffers.

methods.name: setFilteringEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables filtering for transform matrix computation.

methods.name: getCurrentBuffer
methods.description: Returns the buffer associated with the current image.

methods.name: getCurrentTextureTarget
methods.description: Returns the texture target of the current texture.

methods.name: getCurrentCrop
methods.description: Returns the crop rectangle of the current buffer.

methods.name: getCurrentTransform
methods.description: Returns the transform of the current buffer.

methods.name: getCurrentScalingMode
methods.description: Returns the scaling mode of the current buffer.

methods.name: getCurrentFence
methods.description: Returns the fence indicating when the current buffer is ready.

methods.name: getCurrentFenceTime
methods.description: Returns the FenceTime object for the current buffer.

methods.name: setConsumerUsageBits
methods.description: Overrides usage bits with default flags.

methods.name: detachFromContext
methods.description: Detaches the GLConsumer from the current OpenGL ES context.

methods.name: attachToContext
methods.description: Attaches the GLConsumer to a specified OpenGL ES texture in the current context.
